c74object.name: evi.blitwaves~
c74object.digest: No aliasing BLIT oscillators with a choice of simultaneous wave shapes outputs
c74object.description:
evi.blitwaves~ is a 'max define' for the evi_blitwaves.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.blitwaves~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
No aliasing classic synth wave shapes, DSF-BLIT-like algorithm, sweep/modulation works with no noise, and cheap. Good for subtractive synthesis because we stay very bright right up to nyquist, but no hard sync.

inlet.description: PWM 0..1 for wave shapes that use it (RECT, TRI and Train)

outlet.description: Analog Sine wave oscillator with harmonics, output if @addsine attribute set to on.
Naive Train (rectified naive square) wave oscillator, output if @addtrain attribute set to on.
Global phase sync output 0..1, output if @addsync attribute set to on.

attribute.name: addsine
attribute.description: 0 = SINE off (default, no CPU used), 1 = SINE on out of outlet 4

attribute.name: addsync
attribute.description: 0 = off, 1 (default) = main phase output out of outlet 6, 2 = pwm phase output out of outlet 6

attribute.name: addtrain
attribute.description: 0 = off (default, no CPU used), 1 = train based on main phase out of outlet 5, 2 = train based on pwm phase out of outlet 5

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Frequency and Pulse Width smoothed by this time in ms. Turn off (0, default) for audio rate modulation of inlets 1 and 2

c74object.discussion: Also known as 'the pathological blitwaves' © JKC.
